description: This file defines the VideoViewDemo class, an Android activity that demonstrates how to implement video playback with drag-and-drop support using VideoView, MediaController, and handling DragEvent actions.

classes.name: VideoViewDemo
classes.description: An Android activity that showcases video playback with drag-and-drop functionality, utilizing VideoView, MediaController, and handling DragEvent.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and prepares the VideoView for playback, including setting up the drag listener.

methods.name: initPlayer
methods.description: Configures the VideoView with a given URI, attaches a media controller, and requests focus.
